newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan policyholders to face higher premiums-paper.
newsitem.headline: Nissan policyholders to face higher premiums-paper.

text.p: Japan's life insurance industry body has decided to ask policyholders of failed Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co to pay higer premiums and accept lower annuity payments, a Japanese business daily said on Friday.
The decision by the Life Insurance Association of Japan is aimed at making Nissan Life more attractive for the successor company due to take it over, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
As a result, Nissan Life shareholders may have to pay premiums 30 to 40 percent higher than at present, the paper said.
The association was not immediately available for comment on the report.
